description.value: Liquor Giant is a privately operated retail liquor store on Young Road near the Chilliwack Airport, part of the Fraser Valley–based Liquor Giant Group chain operating since 2011. The store stocks a wide selection of spirits, wine, domestic and BC craft beer, and ready-to-drink products, and positions itself on competitive pricing. Third-party delivery through Woww Delivery is also available for those who can't make it in person.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the Chilliwack location at 8247 Young Road with phone 604-792-7717 and email chilliwackliquorgiant@gmail.com, corroborating the OSM address. The site describes a retail liquor store open 365 days a year with in-store pickup and third-party delivery; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging. OSM had no phone listed, so the phone field is sourced from the website.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 604-792-7717 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible retail liquor store with confirmed address and active website; a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: Fraser Valley–based Liquor Giant Group chain operating since 2011
